name: PaletteCopperMine
intent: A stepped copper-mine terrace of deep iron-stained rust-brown spoil parting from cool slag-grey stone and slate-grey far land, with one verdigris green on every pipe, bell and dome under amber lanterns.

critic_pass1.why: Warm rust spoil against a cool grey-green track gives a clear hue split and the verdigris says copper, though the warm ground is a little light and the far land is the same brown as the walk.
critic_pass1.fix: far slate shifted cool grey (toward the slag) so walkable rust and far land part, and walk ground 6 values darker

critic_pass2.why: Far land went from a brown that matched the spoil to cool slate, so walkable and far land now separate; rust spoil against a grey-green road plus verdigris is a clear mine identity.
